plugins.name: Freebuff CLI
plugins.description: CLIProxyAPI plugin that brings Freebuff (codebuff.com) free agents into the gateway as an auth provider and executor. Import one auth token per Freebuff account and the plugin joins the free-tier waiting room for you, rotates upstream agent runs, keeps the free-agent catalogue refreshed, and publishes every model under a freebuff/ namespace so it never collides with another provider. Streaming is passed through frame by frame. Tokens are never logged.
plugins.author: ngojclee
